about.acronyms: Nafath = national digital ID · REGA = Real Estate General Authority · Ejar = government tenancy registry · FAL = real-estate brokerage licence
about.metaDesc: The neutral commercial real estate exchange for Saudi Arabia, powered by SAT Real Estate (REGA FAL 1200025510).
about.title: The neutral commercial real estate exchange for Saudi Arabia, built so every figure can name its source.
about.intro: SAT Markets is an independent, neutral commercial real estate intelligence, leasing, and sales platform, starting in Riyadh. It brings together listings from owners and licensed brokers, a compliant viewing workflow, a rent index derived from the REGA Rental Index (Ejar), and a building-level intelligence map in one platform, delivered English-first with a full Arabic mirror. The platform is in preview on sample data, so the verification standard below describes how a listing will qualify at launch, not a check any preview record has already passed.
about.cardNeutralB: Open to every owner and occupier. Platform-originated stock never silently outranks owner-direct listings.
about.cardCheckedB: This is a publishing standard, not a classifieds board. At launch an owner is checked, the right to lease is confirmed, and an advertising permit is recorded before a listing can carry a verified state. Preview inventory is sample data and holds no permit, so each listing shows only the state its own record supports.
about.cardMoatB: A commercial rent index derived from the REGA Rental Index (Ejar): average rents by district and space type, minimum sample counts, and honest blanks where data is missing.
about.cardComplianceB: Designed around REGA requirements, written mandates, ad-permit gating, and data-protection and e-invoicing by design.
about.verifySub: No anonymous classifieds. The standard has three gates: the person, the right to the property, and the licence. The automated lookups behind each gate arrive before launch, so nothing in this preview has been checked against Nafath, REGA or Ejar.
about.stepNafathB: SAT reviews the person behind each listing before it publishes. Nafath national-ID sign-in, binding identity to the national digital identity, arrives before launch.
about.stepOwnerB: Owners confirm ownership and the right to lease. Automated checks against REGA (the Real Estate General Authority) and the Ejar registry arrive before launch.
about.stepBrokerB: Brokers must hold a valid FAL licence from REGA. Automated verification against the REGA register arrives before launch.
about.stepLiveB: At launch a listing publishes only after all three gates pass, and its verified state names the gate it rests on rather than standing in for all three.
about.foot: SAT Markets, commercial real estate intelligence for Saudi Arabia.

area.intro: Footfall, catchment and co-tenancy. Every figure on this page is sample data. No mobility, spend or demographic source is contracted, so nothing here is a market reading.
area.subject: Subject
area.driveTimeRange: Sample trade-area outline, not a computed travel time
area.coTenancyNote: Occupier mix is drawn from SAT listing records. The mobility, dwell and spend figures are sample data and no source behind them is contracted. What a source has to satisfy before any of them becomes a real figure is set out below.
area.howTitle: What a location source has to satisfy here
area.howH: No global panel covers Saudi Arabia, and an uncontracted source publishes nothing
area.howBody: Global footfall and site-selection platforms are built for United States and European markets, so a Saudi reading has to be sourced locally. SAT will publish a mobility figure only when the source permits aggregate publication in writing, the figure carries its panel basis, aggregation count and period, and user-level output is barred by contract. Until then the numbers above stay sample data.
area.scoreBody: Each site is scored across these five lenses with the reasoning shown, never a black-box number. Works across offices, retail, mixed-use and warehouses, not just retail.
area.pdplNote: Location data is treated as sensitive: anonymised and aggregated. No on-site sensors and no personal images, ever.
area.metaTitle: Location Intelligence, Al Olaya trade area | SAT Markets
area.metaDesc: Sample trade-area page for Al Olaya, Riyadh. Every figure is sample data and no mobility or spend source is contracted.
area.srcMobileB: Not contracted, and nothing on this page comes from one. A mobility source would have to permit aggregate publication, state its panel basis and known biases, and bar user-level output in writing.
area.srcMojB: The transaction portal is a service for people to read, not a data product, so SAT does not scrape it. Calibration against real deals waits on a lawful record-level feed.
area.srcSpendB: Not contracted, and no payment or transaction data reaches SAT. A spend source would need a written agreement, a cross-border basis and a disclosure position before it could inform anything.
area.srcPublicB: GASTAT and SAMA for public context, and the REGA Rental Index (Ejar) for published rental averages with its required attribution. Averages, not medians.

rentIndex.intro: Averages of registered rental contracts, from the REGA Rental Index (Ejar). Districts without enough registered transactions are left blank.
rentIndex.cappedBody: Renewals inside Riyadh’s urban boundary are held at their last Ejar rent for five years under the Sept-2025 decree.
rentIndex.openBody: New-build and first-time leases are unaffected by the cap and continue to re-price to market each term.
rentIndex.benchNote: Every figure below is computed from a source file and traceable to it. Where a district did not clear the minimum transaction count, the cell is blank rather than estimated. Indicative, not advice.
rentIndex.tableNote: Pre-launch sample data illustrating the index mechanism. At launch, averages and bands are computed from verified closed transactions only, and thin samples are marked rather than shown. The index never prints a number it cannot stand behind.
rentIndex.trendB: We do not publish a rent trend yet. A trend needs several quarters of our own verified transactions to stand behind, and we have one quarter. Publishing a line before then would be drawing a shape, not reporting a market. It appears here when the history is real.
rentIndex.heatSubRealThin: Districts with too thin a sample are left blank rather than guessed.
rentIndex.heatSubSample: Preview sample figures. Darker is a higher average. Real district averages appear here at launch.
rentIndex.metaDesc: Saudi commercial rent figures by district and asset type, derived from the REGA Rental Index (Ejar). Averages of registered contracts, with honest blanks where the sample is too thin. Indicative, not advice.
rentIndex.dsDesc: Commercial rent figures derived from the REGA Rental Index (Ejar): averages of registered rental contracts, by district and asset type. Cells that do not clear a minimum transaction count are shown blank rather than estimated. Indicative market context, not advice.
rentIndex.dsBasedOn: REGA Rental Index (Ejar), registered rental contracts
rentIndex.eviBody: Each figure above carries its full record: the kind of statistic, the unit, the source, what SAT did to the number, the reporting period, sample sufficiency, freshness and what the licence permits. Open a figure to read it.
rentIndex.eviNone: No published cells, so there is nothing to evidence yet.
